title: The request to write knob values
description: Writes the values a running sketch declared. Any number of them can go in one call. Placed atomically as ADR-0018 decision 3 requires, and id changes with every request. Within one request they are processed in name order, so writing the same name twice leaves the later one standing.

id.description: This request's identifier. The reply echoes it back.

values.description: The values to write. **Whatever does not go in appears in the reply's rejected, with a reason** — an unknown name, a type that differs, a value outside the choices: none of them is dropped in silence.

name.description: The name as it was declared. It can be looked up in the reply's params.

type.description: The value's type. **Written next to the value**, because JSON's number representation alone cannot tell a real from an integer, and an array alone cannot tell two components from three. A type other than the declared one is refused as typeMismatch.

value.description: The value. float and int are numbers, bool is a boolean, string is text, color is a tuple with red, green, blue and alpha (premultiplied, in the working space), and vec2 and vec3 are arrays of components.
